name: Finmo Payments
author: Finmo Payments

sections.description:
• Install Finmo’s payment plugin with ease and start accepting payments through cards, wallets, and popular local methods instantly.
  • Deliver a seamless and secure checkout experience to your customers with saved cards for quicker payments, reinforced by built-in 3DS fraud protection and PCI DSS-compliant security.
  • Test confidently in sandbox mode to simulate real transactions and ensure everything runs smoothly before going live.
  • Initiate full or partial refunds from your WooCommerce dashboard and track all transactions in real time in your Finmo account.
    Learn how to set up the Finmo Payments plugin on your store (https://docs.finmo.net/docs/woocommerce)

External Services

This plugin connects securely to Finmo’s servers to enable payment processing and related functionality. All APIs used are owned and operated by Finmo.
Service Name: Finmo Payments API
Purpose: Used to process payments, validate API keys, and manage transactions directly from the WooCommerce plugin.

Data Sent

  • Merchant API credentials (for authentication)
  • Payment and order details required to initiate and complete transactions
  • Refund and settlement requests when triggered by the merchant

Data Transmission

All data is transmitted securely over HTTPS only when merchants perform related actions such as checkout, refund, or API key validation.

Service Provider

Finmo Tech Pte. Ltd.
Website: https://finmo.net
API Base URL: https://api.finmo.net
Terms of Service: https://finmo.net/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://finmo.net/privacy-policy
